item.title: US refuses payout for soldiers who died in Iran 'because it isn't a war'
item.description:
📝 Libby Klinner, a widow, wrote on social media that the US air force had deemed her ineligible for additional benefits following the death of Major Alex Klinner, her 33-year-old husband, because Congress had not officially declared war. Alex understood the risks that came with his service, and he trusted that if the worst happened, his family would be taken care of. “I want the conversation to focus on making sure every family facing an unimaginable loss has that same clarity from the start,” said Ms Klinner.
🔗 Read more: https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2026/09/06/pentagon-refused-payout-soldiers-died-in-iran-war/
